info.title: SDAI Easy Diffusion v3 protocol
info.description: Anonymous URL-only integration pinned to Easy Diffusion v3.0.16. Requests describe the supported SDAI subset; response schemas enumerate known upstream fields and tolerate future extension fields. Streaming consists of adjacent JSON objects, not SSE or newline-delimited JSON.

servers.description: Example only; mobile callers use the computer’s reachable LAN URL or reverse-proxy prefix.

parameters.name: task
parameters.description: Positive captured task identity; mandatory for every request.

schema.description: Positive captured task identity; mandatory for every request.

RenderRequest.description: Supported Easy Diffusion v3 render fields. Explicit defaults disable preview images, filters and server-save paths; one output per sequential batch item.

width.description: Requested pixel width, validated before submission.

height.description: Requested pixel height, validated before submission.

seed.description: Resolved unsigned 32-bit seed; random UI sentinels are resolved before HTTP.

use_stable_diffusion_model.description: Exact checkpoint ID from /get/models, including folder separators.

session_id.description: Fresh operation UUID, shared only by this sequential batch.

init_image.description: Optional data:image/...;base64 encoded img2img input; omitted for txt2img when null.

prompt_strength.description: Img2img denoising strength; zero for txt2img.

num_outputs.description: One output per task; batching is sequential in SDAI.

sampler_name.description: Explicit fixed sampler; no upstream sampler discovery is assumed.

output_format.description: Lossless encoded output format stored without reencoding.

stream_image_progress.description: Preview images are disabled; only progress step objects are consumed.

show_only_filtered_image.description: Avoid duplicate original-plus-filtered output arrays; no filters are requested.

save_to_disk_path.description: Server saving is disabled by omitting this null value; SDAI owns normal save/export. A server administrator can independently force saving.

filters.description: Empty postprocessing list; face correction/upscaling/NSFW filters are not requested.

items.description: Filter name, never present in the supported empty list.

Ping.description: Server readiness, optional session task states and runtime diagnostics. SDAI consumes status and ignores diagnostics.

status.description: Server lifecycle state. Online, Rendering and LoadingModel are reachable; Init and Unavailable require retry. Success does not prove generation.

tasks.description: Present when session_id was supplied; keys are decimal Python task IDs.

packages_installed.description: Installed optional package name to version. The pinned manifest currently defines tensorrt.

packages_installing.description: Optional package names currently being installed.

cloudflare.description: Public tunnel address when configured by the server.

models.description: Model entries; SDAI retains only entries tagged stable-diffusion.

Model.description: Server-defined model entry. Folder IDs remain unchanged.

model.description: Complete model identifier supplied back to /render.

name.description: Display label; the exact ID is also visible in SDAI.

tags.description: Model classifications including stable-diffusion for checkpoints.

Submission.description: Accepted task identity and current queue diagnostics. A lost response never permits a second render POST.

task.description: Positive Python task identity used by stream and stop.

stream.description: Task-relative route /image/stream/{task}. SDAI reconstructs and validates the known route beneath the captured prefix.

status.description: Server lifecycle status when the task was accepted.

queue.description: Number of tasks queued at acceptance.

Image.description: Final image returned only with status=succeeded.

data.description: Original Base64 bytes, optionally with a data:image/...;base64 prefix. Must decode to a valid image.

seed.description: Actual output seed supplied by the engine.

path_abs.description: Absolute server save path when saving is enabled; null when not saved.

TaskMetadata.description: Terminal metadata emitted from RenderTaskData, OutputFormatData and SaveToDiskData. Unsupported auxiliary settings are documented for response accuracy and are not enabled by SDAI.

request_id.description: Accepted Python task identity assigned by RenderTask.

vram_usage_level.description: Server memory preset used for generation.

use_face_correction.description: Face-correction model selection, normally null for SDAI.

oneOf.description: Multiple model identifiers reported by the server.

use_upscale.description: Upscaling model selection, normally null for SDAI.

oneOf.description: Multiple model identifiers reported by the server.

latent_upscaler_steps.description: Step count for a latent upscaler, unused by SDAI.

use_stable_diffusion_model.description: Checkpoint identifier or model list reported by the server.

oneOf.description: Multiple model identifiers reported by the server.

filters.description: Applied postprocessing filters; SDAI requests none, but server policy may add a filter.

filter_params.description: Filter-specific parameters supplied by server policy.

oneOf.description: Multiple model identifiers reported by the server.

enable_vae_tiling.description: Whether server VAE tiling is enabled.

show_only_filtered_image.description: Whether only the filtered result is returned.

block_nsfw.description: Whether server policy enables NSFW filtering.

stream_image_progress.description: Whether preview images were requested; false for SDAI.

stream_image_progress_interval.description: Number of sampling steps between preview images.

clip_skip.description: Legacy clip-skip toggle; not enabled by SDAI.

output_format.description: Encoded output format selected for this task.

output_lossless.description: Whether a lossless encoder mode is enabled.

save_to_disk_path.description: Optional server output directory, including any administrator override.

Frame.description: One object in an adjacent-JSON response body. Progress has step/step_time/total_steps and no status; succeeded has output/render_request/task_data; failures have status/detail. EOF never establishes completion. SDAI disables preview frames.

status.description: succeeded is terminal success; failed/stopped/cancelled or unknown terminal states are failures.

step.description: Current completed sampling step; unavailable while queued/loading.

total_steps.description: Sampling total; zero or invalid totals produce indeterminate progress.

output.description: Only succeeded outputs are accepted; exactly one decoded image is required.

items.description: A final encoded image on success, or a preview route on progress when previews are enabled.

detail.description: Backend failure detail. SDAI surfaces a safe actionable message rather than arbitrary server text.

task_data.description: Optional terminal task metadata including the actual selected checkpoint.

step_time.description: Elapsed seconds since the previous sampling callback; -1 for the first callback.

render_request.description: Actual terminal generation parameters after upstream removes large image inputs.

Stop.description: Upstream success is the JSON collection ["OK"], not a free-form object.

Error.description: FastAPI error response for a failed protocol operation.

detail.description: HTTP exception text or FastAPI request-validation issues.

TaskStatuses.description: Decimal task identity to lifecycle status for the requested session.

DeviceInfo.description: Rendering device diagnostics. CPU entries contain only name; accelerator entries also include memory information.

mem_free.description: Free accelerator memory in decimal gigabytes.

mem_total.description: Total accelerator memory in decimal gigabytes.

max_vram_usage_level.description: Highest supported VRAM usage preset for this device.

DeviceMap.description: Device identifier to diagnostics; keys may be cpu, mps, cuda or indexed accelerator identifiers.

Devices.description: Device catalog and currently active rendering devices.

active.description: Devices with a live render worker.

enable_trt.description: Whether the server's TensorRT installation directory exists.

FilterParameters.description: Known filter parameters. Future plugin parameters are ignored by the client.

upscale_faces.description: Whether CodeFormer also upscales restored faces.

FilterParametersByName.description: Filter identifier to typed known parameters; names depend on the enabled postprocessing plugins.

RenderMetadata.description: Actual GenerateImageRequest returned in a terminal success. Large input, mask, reference and control images are removed by upstream before serialization.

prompt.description: Positive prompt used by the engine.

negative_prompt.description: Negative prompt used by the engine.

distilled_guidance_scale.description: Distilled-model guidance scale; unused by SDAI's SD1.5 path.

preserve_init_image_color_profile.description: Whether the input image color profile is preserved.

strict_mask_border.description: Whether a strict inpaint mask border is used.

PreviewImage.description: Optional server progress preview; disabled in requests sent by SDAI.

loc.description: Request parameter location, including array indexes.

items.description: A field name or numeric index.

ProgressFrame.description: Sampling callback; preview output is optional and disabled by SDAI.

status.description: No terminal status is set on sampling progress.

step.description: Current completed sampling step; unavailable while queued/loading.

step_time.description: Elapsed seconds since the previous sampling callback; -1 for the first callback.

total_steps.description: Sampling total; zero or invalid totals produce indeterminate progress.

output.description: Preview routes only when preview streaming was enabled.

SuccessFrame.description: Completed generation with original encoded images and returned parameter metadata.

output.description: Final encoded images returned by the engine.

render_request.description: Actual terminal generation parameters after upstream removes large image inputs.

task_data.description: Optional terminal task metadata including the actual selected checkpoint.

FailureFrame.description: A task that failed or was stopped; no image is accepted from this object.

detail.description: Backend failure detail. SDAI surfaces a safe actionable message rather than arbitrary server text.
